# TI-Boy CE

Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator for the TI-84 Plus CE and TI-83 Premium CE, by calc84maniac (Brendan Fletcher).
Files here are the unmodified release TIBoyCE_Alpha_v0.3.1 (2025-08-22) from https://github.com/calc84maniac/tiboyce/releases.

- TIBOYCE.8xp: the emulator program
- TIBoyDat.8xv: emulator data (required)
- TIBoySkn.8xv: optional skin images

Licence: GNU General Public License v3.0 (see LICENSE.md). Source: https://github.com/calc84maniac/tiboyce.
calc_OS converts Game Boy ROM files to the AppVar format in the browser with its own port of the project's romgen tool (src/lib/tiboy/romgen.ts), verified byte for byte against the original.
